name: Káloz (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow yellow border, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Káloz: a blue shield with a white pelican, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling, above a scroll inscribed KÁLOZ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Káloz arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
